about: BrewDadLabs projects. To add one, add one entry to this list. Status is live, growing or workshop. Links are optional. Keep the description to what it is and what you can do with it; optional note for what comes next.

projects.name: The Arcade
projects.description: Four terminal-style browser games: Snake, Matrix Terminal, Circuit Breaker and System Defender. Free, with no ads, trackers or accounts.

projects.name: StinkDoku
projects.description: Built so someone could play a logic puzzle without sitting through an ad. Play it free in your browser today: no ads, no accounts.
projects.note: Next: the source goes public before the App Store release, which is coming soon.

projects.name: Gorillas 404
projects.description: A remake of the 1991 QBasic Gorillas game: two gorillas, a city skyline and a lot of bananas. It lives on missing pages, so try a broken link on dixhome.com.
projects.note: A reusable version for other sites is on the way.

projects.name: NewEarth Wildlife
projects.description: Dinosaurs for a Minecraft server: small herds of Compsognathus and Stegosaurus that roam the Lost World and react to nearby players and food, for both Java and Bedrock players.
projects.note: The plug-in goes public once it works.

projects.name: NewEarth
projects.description: A Minecraft server and its website, home of the Lost World.

projects.name: Self-hosted systems
projects.description: Home servers and a network built on open tools: a self-hosted search engine and a dynamic DNS service, with no cloud account required.
